svg.title: Trust tiers as bands, the record and the event bus as buses, processes in between
svg.text: T1 · identity and the forge · GitHub today, pluggable
the heart · the application, its own tier
external · a prompt and a key leave, per call
push, fetch · propose a merge, learn the verdict
a narrow role: take a lease, read
voice: a prompt to any backend
the record · refs/dna/* · ordered · append by compare-and-swap · never rewound
nerves · events · NATS in T4 through a bus adapter · after a row lands

g.text: genome and record remotes · decides what merges, with
the surface people reach: sessions, principal → grants,
commands forwarded to the spine with a receipt
the one API the parts call:
git and the forge, ssh, the

svg.text: the skin: each band is a trust boundary, and crossing one takes the credential the table names
NATS lives here too: it is the events bus above
the inference seam: voice conforms to it, hale never depends on voice
